answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 20094 Country: India Title: is it allowed for a man to remove hair of chest, legs and arms? if not, what to do if wife asks for that? Question: is it allowed for a man to remove hair of chest, legs and arms? if not, what to do if wife asks for that? Answer ID: 20094 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 275/B=39/tb =1431) To remove the hair of chest, legs and arms is against etiquettes, one can do so only when necessary. و في حلق شعر الصدر والظهر ترك الأدب كذا في القنية (شامي: 9/583 كتاب الحظر والإباحة). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
